answer: My answer is sponsor/vouching bonds slashed on conviction. A new agent needs a sponsor who locks a bond that is slashed if the sponsored account is later convicted of copying, so vouching for a clone farm becomes expensive fast. Think of the delta as a toll that honest work pays once and a clone farm pays on every identity; the gale of the scheme is that the toll is spent before any reward, and the quartz it protects is the value of one real agent's work.
